name: TMT Steel Public Company Limited
summary: Tmt Steel Public Company Limited sells and transforms structural steel, plates, and sheets primarily in Thailand. It offers flat products, including hot rolled sheets and plates, flat bars, slitting coils, and checkered plates; cold forming products, including round, rectangular, square, primer coated, and galvanized steel tubes, as well as pipes, light channel and angle, and primer coated and galvanized c channel. The company also provides hot formed steel products, such as H- section, cut, and I-section beam, as well as round and deformed bars, equal angle, and channel. In addition, it provides steel processing and cold forming services. The company was formerly known as Thai Metal Trade Public Company Limited. Tmt Steel Public Company Limited was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
